stem: A helpdesk technician is assisting a user who frequently forgets their complex passwords and requests resets weekly. Which of the following security awareness practices should the technician recommend FIRST?

options.text: Writing the password on a sticky note kept under the keyboard
Changing the policy to allow shorter passwords

stem: A newly hired contractor needs access to the corporate network. Before granting access, what type of training MUST the contractor complete to understand the organization's security expectations?
A project team discusses confidential product launch details loudly at a local restaurant while wearing company badges. Which of the following security concepts did the team fail to observe?

A recently demoted employee is observed accessing sensitive corporate financial databases outside of their normal job duties and downloading large archives to a local drive. Which of the following BEST describes this scenario?

A receptionist receives a phone call from an individual claiming to be a vendor requesting the names and email addresses of the IT management team. What type of attack is the receptionist encountering?

A security administrator notices a sudden increase in targeted emails attempting to trick executives into authorizing wire transfers. Which of the following is the BEST immediate action to mitigate this specific threat?

options.text: Implement a mandatory password rotation policy
Restrict internet access for all executive accounts
Install a host-based intrusion detection system on all endpoints
Conduct targeted security awareness training for the finance and executive teams

stem: A security awareness manager is creating a customized training module tailored to the specific risks faced by the human resources department. Which phase of the security awareness program lifecycle does this represent?

A SOC analyst observes a user logging in from an IP address located in a foreign country, followed minutes later by a login from the corporate headquarters. Which of the following BEST describes this event?

A telecommuting employee connects their personal tablet to the corporate VPN to check email while simultaneously downloading untested software from a third-party site. Which focus area of security training does this directly violate?

A user accidentally replies all to an email chain, attaching a spreadsheet that contains unencrypted customer personally identifiable information (PII). Which of the following BEST describes this incident?
A user account that typically downloads five documents a day suddenly attempts to download 5,000 files from a restricted SharePoint site within ten minutes. What type of indicator is this?
A user points out that an email claiming to be from their bank has several spelling errors and uses a generic greeting. Which security awareness skill is the user demonstrating?

After a user clicks the internal "Report Phishing" button in their mail client, the email is automatically removed from their inbox. What is the NEXT logical step in responding to reported suspicious messages?

options.text: The user's computer is immediately wiped and reimaged
The SOC analyzes the email to determine if it is malicious and block the sender
The IT director calls the user to reprimand them
The system sends an automatic reply to the attacker with fake data

stem: An employee finds an abandoned USB drive in the company parking lot. Curious to see who it belongs to, they plan to plug it into their corporate workstation. What training topic BEST addresses preventing this action?

An employee receives an email seemingly from the IT department asking them to click a link and verify their login credentials due to a "server upgrade." Which of the following user actions BEST demonstrates recognizing a phishing attempt?

options.text: Replying to the sender to ask if the email is legitimate
Forwarding the email to their entire department as a warning
Clicking the link but entering incorrect credentials to test the site
Hovering over the URL to check the actual destination before taking action

stem: An employee's mobile device suddenly displays multiple push notifications requesting multi-factor authentication approval, even though the employee is not trying to log in. What type of behavior does this represent?
An executive receives an SMS text message claiming to be from the CEO, requesting the immediate purchase of gift cards for a client. What type of security awareness topic does this scenario describe?
During a security walkthrough, an officer sees an employee leaving their workstation unlocked and unattended in a highly trafficked area. What type of behavior is the employee exhibiting?

During the rollout of a new enterprise-wide password policy, the IT team begins delivering live webinars to staff to explain the changes. Which phase of the security awareness program lifecycle does this represent?
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) wants to measure the effectiveness of the annual security awareness training. Which of the following is the BEST metric to review?

options.text: Reporting and monitoring data on click rates from simulated phishing tests

stem: The help desk receives an automated alert that an employee has reported a suspicious message using the "Phish Alert" button. What should the security analyst do FIRST?

options.text: Analyze the email headers and payload in a sandboxed environment
Reply to the sender and demand they stop sending emails

stem: The security team wants to determine if employees are improving in their ability to detect malicious emails over time. Which of the following BEST provides this measurement?

options.text: Reviewing the firewall logs for dropped packets
Conducting monthly phishing campaigns and tracking the results

stem: To address the rapidly changing landscape of cyber threats, an organization requires all staff to complete a brief security module every quarter. What type of training schedule is this?
Which activity is MOST closely associated with a defensive assessment?

options.text: Developing custom malware to bypass antivirus software
Launching a simulated phishing campaign against internal employees
Attempting to physically breach a restricted data center facility
Analyzing security information and event management (SIEM) rules for effectiveness

stem: While working in a busy coffee shop, an employee angles their laptop screen away from other patrons and uses a privacy filter. Which security awareness concept is the employee actively practicing?
Your organization wants to evaluate how susceptible employees are to clicking malicious links. Which of the following should the security team implement?
